items.title: Prototype one bounded PM4-bypass draw path
items.body:
<!-- lo-project:native-renderer-pm4-bypass-prototype -->

After the architecture map identifies a reproducible candidate, prototype one isolated host-side draw path while retaining the current PM4 path as fallback.

## Scope and completion criteria

- [x] Select one map/draw/pass boundary from the completed architecture map.
- [x] Compare old and candidate paths in the same real scene.
- [x] Record CPU frame time separately from frame pacing and GPU work.
- [x] Verify synchronization and resource lifetime, and retain a reversible fallback.

## Stop/go

A mismatch, lifecycle failure, or no material benefit ends the prototype or returns the candidate to PM4. A passing prototype is evidence only for its selected path and gates, but does not authorize, renderer expansion.

## Sources

- [Architecture boundary map](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/blob/3a950012665bac77c25af36418ebd7916fa1dba4/docs/notes/native-migration-boundaries.md)

Producer attribution and current input/resource snapshots are still required before takeover. Implemented on feature/native-pm4-bypass at ce45afe; draft PR #84. Native SDK state, indexed-quad and four-vertex title-fan commands are consumed in original ring/IB order. Title VS81217dc973d5dc31/PScd6adb98ab83bf90 matched 1486 times by swap1560. Final same-EXE D3D12 title pair exited0 on both paths, but CmdProc CPU/logged-frame rose 1.172737->1.450276ms (+23.7%). items.title: Expand native renderer coverage only after demonstrated gain
items.body:
<!-- lo-project:native-renderer-conditional-coverage-expansion -->

Extend a successful bounded renderer migration in controlled groups such as scenes, battles, UI, and effects.

## Scope and completion criteria

- [ ] Start only after a PM4-bypass prototype records a material, bounded benefit.
- [ ] Keep coverage accounting for each group and compare a representative real scene.
- [ ] Preserve the PM4 fallback and state the rollback trigger for every expanded group.

## Boundary

One-scene or generic FPS observations do not justify expansion. Existing PC Vulkan, D3D12, TAA/MV, stability, and gameplay validation remain separate requirements.

- [Progressive native migration plan](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/blob/main/docs/notes/progressive-native-migration-plan.md)

Track the Vulkan validation `SYNC-HAZARD-PRESENT-AFTER-WRITE` observed on the Streamline/DLSS-G presentation route.

## Recorded evidence and acceptance decision

The 2026-09-27 validation-layer run emitted this message until its duplicate-message limit of 10; 10 is the reporting cap, not a total occurrence count. Monitor upstream Streamline Vulkan synchronization fixes and re-evaluate with a supported SDK update or a reproducible host-side correction. fields.Evidence: Two reporters (v0.7.35 and v0.8.15, 30 FPS, no fast-forward): voice drifts from the lips in real-time cutscenes, more toward the end. Both logs show the audio callback paced exactly to the wall clock (every 1,875-frame interval 10.00 s, no dropped audio progress). On 2026-10-07 a reporter said it was not extremely bad and that the lip sync of the Japanese voices is wrong by design. items.title: [Bug] TAA exits silently while loading a save under Proton (AMD, D3D12)

fields.Evidence: Maintainer report on psvita (Radeon 8060S, RADV, GE-Proton10-34, D3D12 via vkd3d-proton): with TAA the game exited with code 3 when the TAA pipeline was created. Cause: vkd3d-proton's dxil-spirv converted one block of the TAA motion path (a branch that returned twice around the inlined stationary-support helpers) into SPIR-V with an unstructured selection exit; Mesa's parser failed, RADV crashed on the null result in radv_shader_spirv_to_nir, and winevulkan's assert aborted the process past the game's crash handlers. PR #207 gives the block one exit (output unchanged). Verified on psvita: the game loads the map and runs 60 s with TAA, LoTemporalAATest passes under Proton, and the converted SPIR-V passes spirv-val. Not released.

items.title: [Bug] Incorrect white levels

fields.Evidence: Cause: VdGetCurrentDisplayGamma reported sRGB (type 1), so D3D wrote an identity display gamma ramp, and presentation never applied DC_LUT ramps. Xenia reports BT.709 (type 2) and applies the ramp the game then writes (sRGB decode, BT.709 encode); the #78 screenshots match that ramp applied to our output. Expanded RGB range, the #78 workaround, clipped everything above 235 (#179). PR #209 reports type 2 and applies the ramp at presentation (D3D12, Vulkan, Metal checked; psvita screenshot equals the old one through the ramp per pixel). Expanded RGB range stays as an option. Not released.

items.title: Shader delivery: one-file store, startup pack download and cache cleanup (v0.8.0)
items.body:
<!-- lo-project:shader-delivery-v080 -->

v0.8.0 的着色器交付计划（维护者 2026-10-02 提出）：已编译的着色器放进单文件存储，游戏启动时下载着色器包，发布包不再附带着色器包，装好匹配的包后清理与之重复的本地缓存。

## Scope and completion criteria

- [x] [PR #141](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/141)：已编译的着色器按渲染器格式保存在一个只追加的存储文件中（`cache/shaders/shaders_spirv.lostore`、`cache/shaders/shaders_dxil.lostore`），不再每个着色器一个文件；记录以游戏着色器哈希和确切编译输入的 SHA-256 为键，所以翻译器改动后只重新编译生成的 HLSL 有变化的着色器；首次启动把已有的单文件缓存移入存储；新增 Metal 着色器包导出（2026-10-02 已合并，随 v0.7.35 发布）
- [x] [PR #142](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/142)：更新检查之后、着色器预编译之前，没有匹配的着色器包时，游戏提示下载所配置渲染器（Vulkan、DirectX 12、Metal）的着色器包；下载按大小、SHA-256、契约和内容检查，下载超过列出的大小时中止，跳过的选择按契约记住（2026-10-02 07:28 UTC 已合并，随 v0.7.35 发布）
- [x] 把 2026-10-02 导出的 Vulkan、DirectX 12 和 Metal 着色器包发布到 [`shader-packs` 预发布](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/releases/tag/shader-packs)（2026-10-02 已发布；这是预发布，不是版本发布）
- [x] [PR #144](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/144)：发布包不再附带着色器包；Linux 发布 job 运行 `publish_shader_packs.py --check`，版本发布在 `shader-packs` 索引没有列出其运行时的全部三个契约时中止，分支构建只给出警告（2026-10-02 07:55 UTC 已合并，随 v0.7.35 发布）
- [x] 装好匹配的着色器包后，清理与之重复的本地缓存：启动 bundle（`startup_vk12_v1.bundle` 或 `startup_dxil_v1.bundle`，维护者电脑上 963 MB）和包已覆盖的存储记录；把 `builtin/` 文件夹（506 个宿主着色器文件，仍是每个着色器一个文件）并入存储；删除启动 bundle 之前，先测量只靠存储的暖启动

## Validation and acceptance

PR #141：`LoShaderStoreTest`（58 项检查）在 GCC 和 clang（ASan/UBSan）以及 Windows 的 clang-cl 下通过。在维护者缓存副本上做了三次 Vulkan 运行：首次启动用 22.5 秒把 28,687 个单文件移入存储，不调用 DXC；去掉启动 bundle 后，28,687 条记录全部从存储读出，预编译用时 1.8 秒，不调用 DXC。导出的三个着色器包（各 28,687 条记录）都通过了 `verify-runtime`。发布：三个包连同 `index.json` 已于 2026-10-02 07:24:59 UTC 发布到 `shader-packs` 预发布，GitHub 显示的 SHA-256 与导出的文件一致；当时最新的版本发布是 v0.7.25；v0.7.35 在同一天晚些时候发布。

PR #142：先在 Windows 上对本地 HTTP 服务器测试过。之后用已发布的预发布做了真实下载：Windows 上，PR #142 分支的构建在没有索引覆盖的情况下下载并使用了 Vulkan 包（启动后 9 秒装好）和 DX12 包（5 秒）。维护者的 M1 Max（macOS 26.6.2）上，main 2cd3fe6 的 Metal 构建下载了 Metal 包（SHA-256 与发布的一致，启动后 9 秒装好），`new-game-battle` 场景在空着色器缓存下通过（2,047 次绘制，30 FPS），没有编译任何游戏着色器，所有游戏着色器都来自该包。

PR #144：在其分支上运行了一次 Gitea 发布 run（run 126，没有 tag，没有发布任何东西）。构建出的安装包不含着色器包，检查步骤在索引中找到了全部三个契约。v0.7.35 的发布 run（Gitea run 135）使用了这些改动：五个 job 全部成功，Linux job 的着色器包契约检查通过；发布的安装包都不含着色器包：Windows ZIP 77,109,842 字节（v0.7.25 为 254,531,925 字节），AppImage 76,270,072 字节（253,770,232 字节），Flatpak 54,113,384 字节（231,397,328 字节）。

没有验证：PR #141 的运行没有覆盖按需编译路径；整个计划只跑过启动运行和脚本场景，没有较长的游戏过程；Linux 上的下载路径没有运行过，窗口里的鼠标输入也没有测过；下载只在 Windows 和一台 M1 Max Mac 上验证过；发布包的改动先在一次没有 tag 的分支发布 run 里检查过，之后由 v0.7.35 的发布 run 使用，没有记录对已发布 v0.7.35 安装包的启动下载测试；本地缓存清理尚未开始，删除启动 bundle 还需要一次只靠存储的暖启动测量，这也没做。

PR #141、#142 和 #144 已随 v0.7.35 发布（2026-10-02T09:13:35Z），没有玩家确认；本地缓存清理尚未开始；实现、测试、发布与验收分别记录。

stage_detail: Released in v0.7.35 (PR #141, #142, #144) and v0.8.39 (PR #248); not accepted

## Deferred - 2026-10-03

The maintainer deferred the remaining local cache cleanup (removing the startup bundle and store records a matching pack covers, folding `builtin/` into the store, measuring a warm start first) out of v0.8.0. The shipped parts (PRs #141, #142, #144) are unchanged.

## Sources

- [PR #141](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/141)
- [PR #142](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/142)
- [PR #144](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/144)
- [shader-packs prerelease](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/releases/tag/shader-packs)
- [docs/notes/shader-store-2026-10-02.md](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/blob/16cbd5379e4c2da04e3bd0757a39a824490b4bf7/docs/notes/shader-store-2026-10-02.md)
- [docs/PORTABLE_SHADER_PACK.md](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/blob/16cbd5379e4c2da04e3bd0757a39a824490b4bf7/docs/PORTABLE_SHADER_PACK.md#startup-download)
- [v0.7.35 release](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/releases/tag/v0.7.35)

## Scheduled for v0.9.0 — 2026-10-03

The maintainer moved the remaining step, cleaning up the local cache that duplicates an installed shader pack, to v0.9.0. It is no longer deferred; the first four steps shipped in v0.7.35.

## Released - 2026-10-06

The cache cleanup is [PR #248](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/248) (merged 2026-10-06T07:50:09Z as `83bf04da`), released in v0.8.39 (published 2026-10-06T08:48:26Z, not accepted). On a start with a matching pack it deletes the renderer's startup bundle and the store records the pack's index lists, and moves `builtin/` into `builtin_v<translator version>_<format>.lostore`. Measured only on psvita under Proton Direct3D 12 with the Direct3D 12 pack: removing the startup bundle did not change a warm start (17.5-17.7 s to the first map either way), and the cleanup start freed 444,939,750 B of bundle and 290,430,116 B of store records. `LoShaderStoreTest` (95 checks) and `LoBackendCacheTest` pass. Not validated: the Vulkan and Metal paths and the maintainer's own 858 MB store. No reporter or maintainer in-game acceptance is recorded.

fields.Evidence: PR #141 (one-file store), #142 (startup pack download) and #144 (packages without packs, plus a published-index check) shipped in v0.7.35 (2026-10-02T09:13:35Z, not accepted). The last step, the cache cleanup, is PR #248 (merged 2026-10-06T07:50:09Z, shipped in v0.8.39, published 08:48:26Z, not accepted): with a matching pack, the startup bundle and the store records the pack lists are deleted and builtin/ moves into a store. Measured on psvita (Proton Direct3D 12, Direct3D 12 pack): removing the bundle did not change a warm start (17.5-17.7 s to the first map either way); the cleanup start freed 444,939,750 B of bundle and 290,430,116 B of store records in about 0.1 s. LoShaderStoreTest (95 checks) and LoBackendCacheTest pass. Not validated: Vulkan and Metal paths, the maintainer's own 858 MB store. No player confirmation.

items.title: Publish the first macOS package, HDR and tall-screen layouts in v0.7.35

items.title: Fill tall and ultrawide screens with the 3D scene and bar the menus
items.body:
<!-- lo-project:tall-ultrawide-layout-20261002 -->

比 16:9 更高的屏幕（16:10，如 Steam Deck 和 MacBook；以及 3:2 和 4:3）原先会给整个 3D 场景加上下黑边，普通野外菜单的背景在高屏幕和超宽屏上也会超出预期的 16:9 布局。PR #146 让 3D 场景铺满输出：高屏幕增大垂直视野，超宽屏保持水平扩展；UI 和影片保持 16:9 比例，高屏幕上野外小地图向上移动，普通野外菜单加黑边（高屏幕在上下，超宽屏在左右）。已随 v0.7.35 发布。

## Scope and completion criteria

- [x] [PR #146](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/146)：3D 场景铺满高屏幕和超宽屏输出；菜单和 Status 页面按屏幕形状加黑边；小地图向上移动，裁剪与背景、图标、边框和文字使用同一变换；渲染分辨率设置现在决定 16:9 区域的大小（720 在 16:10 屏幕上渲染 1280x800，在 4:3 上渲染 1280x960）
- [ ] 检查战斗、影片、标题画面、Direct3D 12 和 Metal
- [ ] 检查这些屏幕上的帧生成（现在允许运行，没有测过）
- [ ] 发布后取得玩家确认

## Validation and acceptance

items.title: Fix the shader pack contract mismatch behind the full first-launch compile
items.body:
<!-- lo-project:portable-shader-pack-contract-20261002 -->

v0.7.25 附带的是为 v0.7.10 固定的 Vulkan 着色器包，但 macOS 合并后着色器翻译器版本已从 24 变为 26，游戏拒绝了这个包（`portable shader contract mismatch`），首次启动时自行编译全部 28,549 个着色器（16 线程 CPU 上 15 个 worker 用时 180 秒）。发布前没有任何检查把包与运行时对比。PR #127 修复了契约检查；已随 v0.7.35 发布。

## Scope and completion criteria

- [x] [PR #127](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/127)：运行时在导入绑定之前保留解析后的镜像前 `0x185C60` 字节（`UnboundIdentityPrefix()`），渲染器、导出和 `LoShaderPackTool` 共用同一个 `RuntimeContract`；`verify-runtime` 对 SPIR-V 和 DXIL 包做精确检查；用旧定义制作的包不再被接受；本地启动 bundle 仍按绑定后的镜像取键，本地缓存继续有效
- [x] 版本发布在已发布的着色器包没有覆盖其运行时的 Vulkan、DirectX 12 和 Metal 契约时停止（PR #127 先加了发布门禁，[PR #144](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/144) 改为 `publish_shader_packs.py --check`；v0.7.35 的发布 run 通过了这项检查）
- [x] 为新契约重新生成 DirectX 12 着色器包，并连同 Vulkan 和 Metal 包发布到 [`shader-packs` 预发布](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/releases/tag/shader-packs)（2026-10-02）
- [ ] 取得玩家对 v0.7.35 首次启动不再整批编译着色器的确认

## Validation and acceptance

PR #127 合并时：`LoPortableShaderPackTest`（74 项检查）、`LoPortableShaderPackIntegrationTest`（26 项）和 merge CLI 测试通过；`verify-runtime` 用真实的第 1 张光盘镜像接受新包并拒绝 v0.7.25 的包；空缓存下的 `--prepare-shaders-only` 运行对全部 28,549 条记录命中包；本地演练发布门禁时，用 v0.7.25 的包构建失败，用新包通过；Gitea 的只构建发布 run 485 在 Windows 和 Linux 上通过。当时 DirectX 12 包尚未为新契约重新生成，之后已重新生成。v0.7.35 的发布 run 135 通过了包契约检查，发布包不再附带着色器包。

没有记录对已发布 v0.7.35 安装包的首次启动测试，也没有玩家确认；实现、测试、发布与验收分别记录。

fields.Evidence: Released in v0.7.35 (PR #127, with the packs-not-bundled change of PR #144; published 2026-10-02T09:13:35Z, tag commit 95f2c89; not accepted). The v0.7.25 Vulkan pack did not match the shader translator, which had moved from version 24 to 26, so the game rejected it and compiled all 28,549 shaders at first launch (180 s). The runtime contract now uses the image before import binding, verify-runtime accepts the new pack and rejects the v0.7.25 pack, and run 135's Linux job passed the published-index check. The DX12 pack was regenerated. No player confirmation of a first launch on the packaged v0.7.35.

items.title: [Bug] Long pauses in dialog during battles that contain dialog.

fields.Evidence: Closed as completed by the maintainer at 2026-10-03T02:45Z ('solved in 9f52d78'), before the fix was merged (4022256, 16:22Z) and before any release. It shipped only in v0.8.5 (published 18:45:17Z, tag commit 30a76ac; not accepted), not in v0.8.0. The original script code converts each update's elapsed time to a 60 Hz step and drops the fraction above 60 updates per second, so battle script waits never finish; the hook carries the fraction (LO_BATTLE_SCRIPT_TIMER=0 turns it off). A generated guest fixture passes at 30, 60, 90 and 120 Hz and its negative control stays stuck; no live comparison in the reported scenes is recorded. The reporter's 06:14Z comment says the pauses seem tied to frame rates above 60 FPS: a statement about the cause, not a test of the fix. No reporter confirmation.

fields.Evidence: Closed as completed by the maintainer at 2026-10-03T19:03Z (who wrote that it should be fixed in 0.8.5 and asked for a report if not), 18 minutes after v0.8.5 was published. The maintainer identified it from the reporter's video as the #148 bug (waits in battle scripts never finish at 90 or 120 FPS) and suggested 60 or 30 FPS until the release. The fix (9f52d78, merged as 4022256 at 16:22Z) shipped in v0.8.5, not v0.8.0; see issue-148-battle-dialogue-pauses for the cause and checks. The reporter attached no log and gave no frame rate, version or platform, and has not replied, so neither the cause nor the fix is confirmed for this report. Not accepted.

A power blink after saving left .lo-content as 308 zero bytes while save.bin survived, so Continue hid the slot. PR #178 listed renamed folders (not the cause); PR #181 lists a save whenever save.bin has data and syncs saves to disk. Checked locally on a Windows build with the reporter's own save.bin and a zeroed .lo-content (lists and loads The White Boa - Brig) plus LoStorageTest modes. Not covered: CREATE_ALWAYS still clears the old container before the game rewrites it. The reporter wrote 'Its all working now' at 18:48Z without naming a build; the maintainer's 18:50Z request to confirm Continue on v0.8.5 has no recorded answer.

items.title: Add a No Random Encounters switch to the F1 Debug Menu
items.body:
<!-- lo-project:debug-no-random-encounters-20261003 -->

F1 调试菜单的 Overview 页在 Save Anywhere 下方新增“No Random Encounters”开关，和 Save Anywhere 一样保存在 `settings.ini`（`no_random_encounters`）。开启后，野外行走遇敌更新里一次成功的抽取会被改成“不战斗”；已走距离的计数和阈值更新照常运行，剧情战斗不走这条路径。它是在排查 Issue #171 时提出的，当时反复的随机战斗拖慢了复现。已随 v0.8.5 发布。

## Scope and completion criteria

- [x] [PR #180](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/180)：菜单新增一行（Win/Cancel 下移一行），开关持久化，开启时行走遇敌的成功抽取不进入战斗
- [ ] 检查其他区域、开关打开时的剧情战斗和长时间游玩
- [ ] 发布后取得玩家确认

## Validation and acceptance

本地通过 `LoDebugMenuInteractionTest`（新行双向切换、末行边界）、`LoDebugOverlayTest` 和 `LoSaveAnywhereConfigTest`（INI 读取、非法值、普通设置保存后仍保留）。PR 记录：在 120 FPS、第四碟 Great Ancient Ruins、开关打开时走过 Hanging Corridor 和 Lunar Palace 没有随机战斗，RB 换人和柱子机关正常。其他区域、开关打开时的剧情战斗和长时间游玩没有检查。

已随 v0.8.5 发布，没有玩家确认；实现、测试、发布与验收分别记录。

stage_detail: Released in v0.8.5; awaiting broader validation

## Sources

- [PR #180](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/180)
- [Issue #171](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/issues/171)
- [v0.8.5 release](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/releases/tag/v0.8.5)

fields.Evidence: Released in v0.8.5 (PR #180, merged 2026-10-03T17:59:46Z; published 18:45:17Z, tag commit 30a76ac; not accepted). F1 Debug Menu switch below Save Anywhere (settings.ini no_random_encounters): a successful walking-encounter draw becomes no battle, distance counters still run, scripted battles are unaffected. Requested while investigating #171. LoDebugMenuInteractionTest, LoDebugOverlayTest and LoSaveAnywhereConfigTest passed locally; at 120 FPS in disc 4, Great Ancient Ruins, the PR author walked the Hanging Corridor and Lunar Palace without random battles and RB party switching and the pillar mechanisms worked. Other areas, story battles with the switch on and long play were not checked. No player confirmation.

items.title: [Bug The great ancient ruins Disc 4, unable to go further due to a bug

fields.Evidence: In the Lunar Palace the two platforms that start with pillars on them rose by themselves after a random battle, leaving the pillars floating. The cause was the #114 touch-entry guard (PR #135, shipped in v0.7.35); it made the per-frame touch poll read false while a battle request was queued, and the platform scripts read that as no pillar on the platform. The guard was removed in v0.8.6 (commit 058d8ffd; published 2026-10-03T20:46:53Z; not accepted). The maintainer verified it with the reporter's save on a diagnostic build, not the release package: with the guard one battle broke the platform, without it the platform stayed down. Closed as completed by the maintainer at 2026-10-03T20:54:17Z after replying that v0.8.6 fixes it. The reporter has not replied, so there is no reporter confirmation. Saves made after the platform had risen keep that state. The removal re-opens the #114 softlock window.

items.title: [Bug] Helio G99 Black Menus

fields.Evidence: Samsung SM-A075M (Helio G99, Mali-G57) showed black menus and world with tens of thousands of 'texture creation failed fmt=18/20' lines: Mali drivers do not expose textureCompressionBC, so every BC1/BC3 texture was dropped. PR #241 (merged 2026-10-06T05:38:58Z, shipped in v0.8.37) reads the capability and decodes BC to RGBA8 on the CPU when it is missing. Validation: LoBcDecodeTest (81 known-answer checks) and a psvita A/B with LO_TEXTURE_BC=0 forcing the decode path. Not validated: no Mali device, so the real detection path never ran; Vulkan with the fallback and phone CPU cost not measured. The maintainer asked the reporter to try the release (2026-10-06) and closed the Issue as completed on 2026-10-07 at 19:27:08 UTC. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Feature] Please Add Aspect Ratio

fields.Evidence: On Android the status and navigation bars stayed visible in game. PR #240 (merged 2026-10-06T05:49:54Z, shipped in v0.8.37, not accepted) hides the bars with sticky-immersive behaviour and draws under the display cutout. Checked on a Lenovo TB321FU (no cutout, gesture navigation). The Issue was closed with the PR merge at 05:49:55Z; the maintainer asked the reporter to confirm on the Odin 2 Portal. Regression: players reported on Reddit that v0.8.37 and v0.8.39 show the bars again (SDL posts a window-style command that undoes the hide); PR #256 (merged 2026-10-06T14:26:13Z) fixes it and shipped in v0.8.44, checked on the tablet only (no cutout, no three-button navigation). No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Bug] CGI Videos play in japanese regardles of language selected

fields.Evidence: CGI movies, including the title intro, played the Japanese audio track whatever language was selected. Cause: the movie player picks the track with the registry ID of the cached voice code, the registry's codes are lower case, and the host language hook returned the executable's upper-case table entry ('INT'), so the case-sensitive lookup missed and the ID was 0 (the Japanese track). PR #242 (merged 2026-10-06T06:46:52Z, shipped in v0.8.37, published 07:46:23Z, not accepted) returns the registry's own record, and also addresses #54. Validation: tools/tests/guest_language_test.py with lower-case registry codes passes (old policy resolves ID 0, new one the registry ID, English and Italian cases) and a psvita (Proton, Direct3D 12, USA disc 1, English text) LO_TRACE_LANGUAGE trace shows voice id 0 on main and 1 on the branch. Not checked: nobody listened to the audio and only English text was traced. The Issue was closed with the PR merge at 06:46:54Z. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: Stop first-use pipeline stalls on all platforms (P0 to P4)
items.body:
<!-- lo-project:pipeline-first-use-stalls -->

The first visit to a map, the first battle with a new enemy or the first view of a cutscene stalls while new graphics pipelines are created, up to about 1.3 s on the TB321FU tablet; recorded recipes never cover every VS/PS pair. The plan is in [docs/notes/pipeline-first-use-stalls.md](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/blob/fd7d82ced444b2102770faa4bdeb9bac5efee607/docs/notes/pipeline-first-use-stalls.md). The maintainer scheduled the item for v0.9.0 on 2026-10-05.

## Scope and completion criteria

- [x] P0: runtime pipeline miss log (`renderer: pipeline misses` per frame, `LO_PIPELINE_MISS_LOG=1`, `tools/pipeline_misses.py`) - [PR #249](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/249), merged 2026-10-06T08:24:01Z, released in v0.8.39
- [x] P1: persistent driver pipeline caches (`VkPipelineCache`, `ID3D12PipelineLibrary`, `MTLBinaryArchive` off by default, Mesa cache directory on Android) and recipes saved on every exit - PR #249, released in v0.8.39
- [x] P2: Vulkan graphics pipeline library - [PR #260](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/260) (render pass dependencies, merged 2026-10-06T22:52:01Z as `7f3806b3`) and [PR #259](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/259) (draw-time pipelines linked from pipeline library parts, merged 2026-10-06T23:12:35Z as `b7592d06`); released in v0.8.53
- [x] P3: recipe corpus with a battle tour and per-scene prefetch - [PR #261](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/261) (scene-tagged recipes and prefetch, merged 2026-10-06T23:54:57Z as `2c8f7d07`), [PR #263](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/263) (battle tour, merged 2026-10-07T00:23:48Z as `6760b23e`) and [PR #264](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/264) (corpus download, merged 2026-10-07T00:24:17Z as `627009a9`); released in v0.8.53
- [x] P4: parallel creation of the remaining misses - [PR #262](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/262) (merged 2026-10-07T00:23:04Z as `75c75e3e`); released in v0.8.53

## Validation and acceptance

PR #249 measurements (2026-10-06, psvita, AMD Radeon 8060S, driver disk cache off): startup prebuild of 1950 recipes 2648 ms cold and 888-908 ms warm under Proton Direct3D 12 (cache 35.4 MB), 2124 ms and 955-1022 ms on native Linux Vulkan (8.8 MB). Entering Uhra on Proton Direct3D 12 with no prebuild: 243 draw-time creations, 3221 ms cold, 50 ms warm, worst frame 1893 ms to 26 ms. M1 Max Metal: the binary archive gave no gain (13.5 s cold against about 5.3 s with the system cache, plus 1.8 s to load 62 MB), so it is off by default (`LO_METAL_BINARY_ARCHIVE=1`). `LoDriverPipelineCacheTest` passes. Not validated: native Windows NVIDIA and AMD drivers, the Android Mesa cache directory (tablet locked, no numbers), gameplay on Mac and native Linux, the exit flush on window close and kernel exit, and the Metal archive while playing. P0 and P1 are released in v0.8.39 (published 2026-10-06T08:48:26Z, not accepted); as of 2026-10-06, P2 to P4 were not started (they are merged since, see the 2026-10-07 section).

stage_detail: All phases released (P0 and P1 in v0.8.39, P2 to P4 in v0.8.53); the maintainer accepted the effect on an Android debug build, not on the release packages

## Sources

- [PR #249](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/249)
- [v0.8.39 release](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/releases/tag/v0.8.39)
- [docs/notes/pipeline-first-use-stalls.md](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/blob/fd7d82ced444b2102770faa4bdeb9bac5efee607/docs/notes/pipeline-first-use-stalls.md)
- [docs/notes/pipeline-first-use-stalls.md at 627009a9](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/blob/627009a9d1860696cd20ca738c6f8631197c8683/docs/notes/pipeline-first-use-stalls.md) (P2, P3, P4 and corpus tour sections)
- [PR #259](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/259), [PR #260](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/260), [PR #261](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/261), [PR #262](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/262), [PR #263](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/263), [PR #264](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/264)
- [shader-packs prerelease](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/releases/tag/shader-packs) (`pipelines_corpus-80afef9497d4bb14.bin` and `index.json`)
- [v0.8.53 release](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/releases/tag/v0.8.53)

## Merged for v0.9.0 - 2026-10-07

P2 to P4 are merged on main and not released: v0.8.44 (published 2026-10-06T17:34:21Z) predates all six pull requests, so no published package carries them. No player or maintainer in-game acceptance is recorded. The merge states and times above were read with `gh pr view` at about 00:26 UTC.

- P2: [PR #260](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/260) (`7f3806b3`) gives the pipeline render passes the framebuffer pass dependencies (validation message VUID-vkCmdDraw-renderPass-02684). [PR #259](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/259) (`b7592d06`): on Vulkan devices with `VK_EXT_graphics_pipeline_library` and extended dynamic state, a pipeline first needed during a draw is fast-linked from per-shader library parts instead of compiled whole, and a background thread precompiles the parts for the known recipes; `LO_NO_PIPELINE_LIBRARY=1` turns it off. Direct3D 12 and Metal are unchanged.
- P3: [PR #261](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/261) (`2c8f7d07`) normalizes recipes, stores the map or battle each one appeared in (recipe file format 2) and builds a scene's known pipelines on worker threads while it loads; an optional recipe corpus is added to the known recipes. [PR #263](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/263) (`6760b23e`) adds the battle tour debug command (`LO_DEBUG_BATTLE_FILE`) and `tools/recipe_tour.py`. [PR #264](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/264) (`627009a9`) downloads the corpus from the `shader-packs` index (its `pipeline-corpus` entry) and keeps it updated in the background.
- Corpus: 3934 recipes, `pipelines_corpus-80afef9497d4bb14.bin` (SHA-256 `80afef9497d4bb14b600c91693d48e9f876fcb6f00c546f44f634b377fac24dc`), uploaded to the `shader-packs` prerelease at 2026-10-07T00:15Z with the maintainer's go-ahead; the index lists 8 entries. `gh release view shader-packs` at about 00:27 UTC listed the file with that digest. The prerelease is not a version release: the corpus downloader is in the P3 pull requests on main, so v0.8.44 players do not fetch it.
- P4: [PR #262](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/262) (`75c75e3e`) puts scene prefetch, sibling recipes and skipped draws on one prioritized worker pool. When a draw misses, known recipes that share its shaders are built on other cores at the same time (off on Metal, `LO_PIPELINE_SIBLINGS=1` turns it on); each worker has its own pack reader; `LO_PIPELINE_ASYNC=1` skips a draw whose pipeline is not ready yet (default off; objects can be missing briefly).

Validation: everything was measured on psvita (AMD Radeon 8060S, RADV) and an M1 Max. P2 ran under Proton (Vulkan) and on native Linux with the Khronos validation layer, which reported nothing specific to the new path; P3 under Proton Direct3D 12 and on the M1 Max (Metal); P4 under Proton Direct3D 12 and Vulkan and on the M1 Max. P4 gained time on Direct3D 12 only; Vulkan and Metal stayed within the run-to-run noise. The numbers are in the P2, P3, P4 and corpus tour sections of the [note](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/blob/627009a9d1860696cd20ca738c6f8631197c8683/docs/notes/pipeline-first-use-stalls.md), not repeated here. Not tested anywhere: Android (TB321FU, Turnip), which is where the 1.3 s stall was measured and where the plan's acceptance targets were set; NVIDIA and Intel Windows Vulkan drivers; a cold Metal system cache. The note also records P4 on native Linux Vulkan as not measured. Implementation, measurement, publication of the corpus and release are separate: the code is merged, the corpus is published, nothing is released, and nothing is accepted.

## Android result and acceptance - 2026-10-06

On the TB321FU tablet (Turnip Mesa 26.0.0-devel, debug build 0.8.45-dev-pipeline of main 2b5044af) the first visit to Uhra and the first battle created no pipelines at draw time with the corpus; under the old conditions the same visit created 155 (7349 ms, worst frame 2028 ms). Costs: a cold first-start prebuild of about 18 s (0.48 s on the next start) and slower map loads for the 115-140 s the background library build takes after a cold start; a partly covered map (u32) still showed a 446 ms frame cold. The maintainer accepted the effect and asked for no further tuning. Details: docs/notes/pipeline-first-use-stalls.md, section "Android 实测".

## Released in v0.8.53 - 2026-10-07

v0.8.53 (published 2026-10-07T08:09:55Z, tag commit `c3bce085`) carries P2 to P4: PRs #259 to #264 are ancestors of the tag commit (checked with `git merge-base --is-ancestor`), and the CHANGELOG lists them as four first-use stall items (Vulkan pipeline libraries, per-scene prefetch, DirectX 12 sibling builds and the recipe list download). With it every phase of the plan is released: P0 and P1 in v0.8.39, P2 to P4 in v0.8.53. The Release field changes from v0.9.0 (the maintainer's 2026-10-05 schedule) to v0.8.53, the release that completes the item; the P0 and P1 release stays in the Evidence. The corpus (`pipelines_corpus-80afef9497d4bb14.bin`, 3934 recipes) was already on the `shader-packs` prerelease before the release (2026-10-07T00:15Z), so v0.8.53 players can fetch it; the release assets do not contain it. No shader pack was published with the release: the pack contracts are unchanged. Acceptance: the maintainer accepted the Android result on 2026-10-06 (debug build of `2b5044af`, not the release packages). No game run was made with the v0.8.53 packages and no player confirmation is recorded; the not-tested list above is unchanged.

fields.Evidence: All phases are released. P0/P1 shipped in v0.8.39 (PR #249). P2-P4 shipped in v0.8.53 (published 2026-10-07T08:09:55Z, not accepted): #260/#259 (Vulkan pipeline libraries), #261 (scene-tagged recipes, loading-screen prefetch), #262 (shared worker pool, siblings), #263 (battle tour), #264 (corpus download; the 3934-recipe corpus was published to shader-packs 2026-10-07T00:15Z, before the release). Measured on psvita (RADV) and an M1 Max. Android TB321FU (Turnip, debug build of 2b5044af, 2026-10-06): with the corpus the first Uhra visit and first battle created no draw-time pipelines (old conditions 155, worst 2028 ms); cold first-start prebuild ~18 s (0.48 s on the next start). The maintainer accepted the effect on that build without further tuning; no game run with the v0.8.53 packages. Not tested: NVIDIA/Intel Windows Vulkan, cold Metal cache.

items.title: [Feature] CTRL icon can be moved and change opacity

fields.Evidence: Request (2026-10-06): move the Android on-screen CTRL button and make it follow the opacity setting. PR #254 (merged 2026-10-06T16:37:43Z, shipped in v0.8.44, published 17:34:21Z, not accepted) makes it draggable in the touch-layout editor, saved with the layout, and the full button follows the opacity slider; it slides to the nearest screen edge after 4 s idle and a tap on the tab brings it back (setting Auto-hide CTRL button, on by default). PR #257 retracts the top tab to the physical top edge. Validation: Android unit tests pass; behaviour checked on a Lenovo TB321FU with debug APK builds. Not covered: other devices and screen shapes, the reporter's device. The Issue was closed by the PR #254 merge at 16:37:44Z. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Bug] Android: ISO importer error

fields.Evidence: On Android all four USA/EU ISOs failed with 'File extends beyond image' although they work on the PC. On the maintainer's tablet a synthetic complete disc 1 image (5.98 GB) imported fine and a copy cut at 4,294,967,295 bytes (what FAT32 leaves) failed with the reporter's message, so the cause is an incomplete copy, not an importer bug. PRs #252 and #255 (merged 2026-10-06T13:52:25Z and 14:04:26Z, shipped in v0.8.44, published 17:34:21Z, not accepted) name the file size, the missing bytes and the likely cause, and wrap long scan errors. The wrapping was checked with a preview render test, not on a device. The Issue is open; the maintainer replied after the release. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Bug] FSR 3.1 scaling & performance issue

fields.Evidence: Reported on v0.8.0 (RX 6600, 4K, GTAO): FSR Quality, Balanced and Performance all ran at about the same frame rate. PR #189 (shipped in v0.8.10) stopped recreating the SR images every frame; PR #250 (shipped in v0.8.44) cut one full-resolution copy and blend per frame; PR #305 (merged 2026-10-08T00:39:50Z as 26ad776c, shipped in v0.8.61, published 08:33:11Z, not accepted) folds the FSR encode into the composite and defers the restore resample (psvita, 12 W, 4K FSR Performance: 51.66 to 48.64 ms GPU). Measured on psvita (AMD) and, for #305, also checked with DLSS on an RTX 5080; not on the reporter's machine. The maintainer closed the Issue as completed on 2026-10-07 at 22:59:34 UTC; on 2026-10-08 the reporter was asked to rerun on v0.8.61 and did (18:21 UTC: Native AA 24 fps, FSR Quality 38, Balanced 43, Performance 50), seeing no change beyond the margin of error. No reporter confirmation is recorded. Moving-only motion replay is scheduled for v1.0.0.

Assets: Windows ZIP 150,316,921 B (SHA-256 be6f6476...; now includes the XeSS libraries), Linux AppImage 76,364,280 B (a00d2e77...), Flatpak 54,125,296 B (005b3923...), Android APK 45,222,430 B (52ae9ee6...; CI-built) and macOS DMG 60,476,104 B (322dd378...; built on the maintainer's M1 Max from the tag, codesign verify passes with an ad-hoc signature, uploaded by hand). items.title: [Bug]  Flickering/Incorrect shadows on Steam Deck

fields.Evidence: Steam Deck (AMD) report: character and object shadows shake and flicker whatever the settings. PR #186 (merged 2026-10-04T02:19:39Z as eb69e6b6, shipped in v0.8.10, published 05:39:20Z, not accepted) rebuilds the pixel position from SV_Position in the shadow-projection pixel shaders; AMD's interpolated position was off by several texels. Checked by eye on an AMD Radeon 8060S (RADV, Proton Direct3D 12) in Uhra Main Street and on an RTX 5080 (shadows unchanged); LoShadowProjectionShaderTest passes. Not run on a Steam Deck or the reporter's machine. The Issue was closed by the merge at 02:19:40Z. The reporter wrote 'Thanks so much, you solved!' at 2026-10-04T12:52:53Z, after v0.8.10 was published, replying to the maintainer's 'Fixed, releasing'; it names no build and describes no test, so it is recorded as reporter-reported, not as acceptance.

items.title: [Bug] Flickering shadows

fields.Evidence: Reporter (RTX 4060, Direct3D 12, DLSS Balanced): dark block shadows on characters in real-time cutscenes with TAA or upscaling. PR #197 (merged 2026-10-04T11:28:57Z as 0f8a8bb0, shipped in v0.8.15, published 11:52:16Z, not accepted) stops the 720x720 cutscene pre-pass from becoming the scene's jitter anchor and extends the receiver jitter compensation to all twelve shadow-projection shaders. Checked on an RTX 5080 (DLSS Balanced, cutscene RT_064A) and an AMD Radeon 8060S (Proton, FSR Balanced, RT_064A and RT_063B); LoTemporalJitterTest passes. Not run on the reporter's machine. The Issue was closed by the merge at 11:28:58Z. The reporter wrote at 12:48Z that it seemed to work, then at 13:56Z that flicker continued on v0.8.15 in other scenes, and opened #212 (fixed in v0.8.30). Not accepted.

items.title: [Bug] Android, game crashing at start

fields.Evidence: Android (Adreno 650): the game stopped at 'descriptor/push-constant limits below renderer layout'. v0.8.10 (PRs #187 and #188) made the launcher show the failure reason and open the GPU driver page; the reporter confirmed that at 16:13Z but the game still failed on several Turnip drivers. PR #205 (merged 2026-10-04T17:09:26Z as 80d2ae9a, shipped in v0.8.21, published 22:02:56Z, not accepted) sets tu_dont_reserve_descriptor_set before the custom driver loads, because Turnip reserves one of the five descriptor sets the renderer needs. Checked by CI builds only; no Adreno 6xx device run. The Issue was closed by the merge at 17:09:27Z. The reporter answered 'Will do' when asked to retry with T19 and attach a log; no result and no reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Bug] Sea of baus flickering sky

fields.Evidence: Reporter (AMD 7900 XTX, Direct3D 12, FSR native AA, 4K): the sky flickers when a Sea of Baus battle starts with TAA, FSR or DLSS. PR #204 (merged 2026-10-04T16:59:02Z as 06c3e657, shipped in v0.8.21, published 22:02:56Z, not accepted) adds the sky shader pair bda41a11/fd46e019 to the jittered sky pairs. Validation is a fixture test on the logged register banks (LoTemporalJitterTest --captured-issue203-sky, fails against the previous map); no run in a Sea of Baus battle. The Issue was closed by the merge at 16:59:03Z. The reporter wrote 'It's fixed, no more flickering!' at 2026-10-05T15:10:59Z, after v0.8.21 was published; it names no build, so it is recorded as reporter-reported, not as acceptance.

items.title: [Bug] Still flickering at some parts using DLSS and TAA

fields.Evidence: Reporter (RTX 4060, Direct3D 12, DLSS Balanced, TAA): flicker remaining after #183 in the Old Sorceress' Mansion battle floor and the Tolten cutscene. PR #218 (merged 2026-10-05T00:39:44Z as 87ed5142, shipped in v0.8.30, published 20:54:12Z, not accepted) jitters the per-light floor passes and uses each frame's matching camera for shadow volumes and lights in two-view cutscenes. Checked on an RTX 5080 (DLSS Balanced, TAA, AO) with a diagnostic build: the maintainer watched the cutscene, the courtyard battle ground and the Entrance Hall enemy light in the foreground and accepted them; LoTemporalJitterTest and LoTemporalSceneTest pass. Not covered: AMD, macOS, other two-view shots, the reporter's machine. Closed by the merge at 00:39:45Z; the reporter has not replied.

items.title: [Bug] Enemies not fading in during the first battle

fields.Evidence: Enemies popped in instead of fading in when targets switched in the first battle (Vulkan). Fading enemies use constant-colour blend factors; the guest ramps the constant but the renderer never passed it to the host, so it stayed 0. PR #225 (merged 2026-10-05T07:50:17Z as e82cb6d1, shipped in v0.8.30, published 20:54:12Z, not accepted) sets the blend constant per draw on Direct3D 12, Vulkan and Metal and applies to every constant-factor blend. Checked on Windows, first battle on Vulkan at 30 FPS: the logged constant ramps 0.11 to 0.99 over about 11 frames at every target switch; no validation-layer errors with TAA. The Metal change compiles only in CI and the maintainer's visual check was listed as pending. Other scenes may now show effects that used to be invisible. The Issue was closed by the merge at 07:50:18Z; no reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Bug] Polygons visible during white flashes with Ambient Occlusion ON (Memory unlock, Enemy attacks)

fields.Evidence: Polygon outlines showed through white flashes with ambient occlusion on (Low Town memory unlock, enemy attacks). The game's full-screen white fade is drawn before bloom and tone mapping, but AO is applied to the finished scene copy. PR #238 (merged 2026-10-05T23:08:08Z as 6fb29ebd, shipped in v0.8.37, published 2026-10-06T07:46:23Z, not accepted) scales AO strength by the fraction of the scene left visible and skips AO when nothing is left. Checked with the reporter's save on an RTX 5080 (Direct3D 12, GTAO) at the memory unlock only; the enemy-attack flashes were not reproduced; SSAO, Vulkan and other GPUs not checked. The Issue was closed by the merge at 23:08:10Z. On 2026-10-06T17:31:35Z the reporter posted a video and a save showing the outlines still appear during enemy attacks (the boss fight after the door) on v0.8.39; the Issue is still closed and no reply or follow-up fix is recorded.

items.title: [Feature]  andriod port back up saves like cloud and touch screen fast foward lt doesnt work

fields.Evidence: Request: Android save backup (like cloud) and an on-screen LT that starts fast-forward. PR #222 (merged 2026-10-05T06:28:56Z) adds CTRL > Saves, which exports every slot to one ZIP and imports a ZIP of a PC save folder, Xenia userNN folders or the RGH converter layout, replacing a slot only after confirmation; PR #223 (merged 06:57:07Z as 298e9c5c) makes the on-screen LT feed fast-forward. Both shipped in v0.8.30 (published 2026-10-05T20:54:12Z, not accepted). SaveTransferTest (5 JUnit tests) passes and the Android Java sources compile; both PR bodies say not run on a device. This is a ZIP export and import, not cloud sync. The Issue was closed with PR #223 at 06:57:09Z; the maintainer commented 'Coming in the next release' at 06:58:01Z. No reporter reply or confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Feature] add Xbox 360 trainers

fields.Evidence: Request (2026-10-06): add Xbox 360 trainers (cheats) to the menu. The maintainer closed the Issue as completed at 2026-10-06T05:03:27Z with the comment 'its already there', meaning the existing cheat functions cover the request. No pull request, commit or release change was made for it, so there is nothing to ship or validate. No reporter reply is recorded.

items.title: [Feature] QoL: Make game menu animation faster

fields.Evidence: Request (2026-09-30): make the game menu animation about twice as fast. The maintainer declined a separate switch (original game behaviour; 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-06) and pointed to the debug menu's fast-forward, which also speeds the menu animation; the reporter then asked for those settings to persist ('will do', 2026-10-07). PR #269 (merged 2026-10-07T03:01:14Z as 35e22a28, shipped in v0.8.53, published 2026-10-07T08:09:55Z, not accepted) saves the F1 Cheats fast-forward switch, Hold/Toggle mode and 2x-8x rate to settings.ini (fast_forward, fast_forward_mode, fast_forward_rate) and restores them at start. Checked with the config and debug-menu tests and on psvita (Proton D3D12: on, Toggle, 4x survived a restart); the quit path was not run. The Issue was closed with the PR merge at 03:01:15Z. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Feature] Make the options menu Animated.

fields.Evidence: Request (2026-10-02): the host Settings menu has no animations. PR #317 (merged 2026-10-08T06:07:26Z as 07e2de78, shipped in v0.8.61, published 08:33:11Z, not accepted) eases the menu, presentation only: the content fades in over 220 ms on open, and tab switches, cursor moves, value changes, dialogs and the display countdown cross-fade over 150 ms; closing stays instant. Checked with LoMenuRenderTest, LoMenuFlowTest, CPU contracts 33/33 and settings_menu contracts 5/5; in game only one psvita run before the timer fix, none on the merged code. The Issue was closed with the merge at 06:07:27Z; the maintainer commented the release on 2026-10-08 at 08:34:55Z. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Feature] 5.1 Audio

fields.Evidence: Request (2026-10-03): add 5.1 audio output, since the original mix is 5.1. PR #271 (merged 2026-10-07T03:35:13Z as a5fa8961, shipped in v0.8.53, published 2026-10-07T08:09:55Z, not accepted) adds Settings > Audio > Audio output: Stereo (default) or 5.1 surround (audio_output), applied live. The six channels pass through unmixed; fewer channels fall back to stereo with a log line and a help hint; 7.1 takes the 5.1 stream through SDL. PR #279 (merged 07:43:18Z, v0.8.53) names the Windows Sound control panel steps in that hint. Checked on psvita (Proton/WASAPI, null sinks): all six channels carry sound, the stereo fold matches within 0.1 dB, a 2-channel sink falls back, a 7.1 sink reopens. The maintainer confirmed 5.1 on an HDMI soundbar set to 7.1 in the classic Sound panel (log: 8 channels, 5.1 stream mapped; maintainer's report, before the release). Not tested: native Linux, macOS, Android, the commenter's 5.1 setup. Closed with the PR merge at 03:35:15Z. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Feature] Allow adjusting the rumble intensity

fields.Evidence: Request (2026-10-04): add an option for the rumble intensity, which is too strong on a DualSense. PR #270 (merged 2026-10-07T03:17:30Z as 3182adab, shipped in v0.8.53, published 2026-10-07T08:09:55Z, not accepted) adds a Vibration slider to Settings > Audio: 0-100 % in 10 % steps, default 100 (retail), saved as vibration. It applies at once, rescales a rumble that is already running and plays a short preview pulse; the minimum turns rumble off and LO_CONTROLLER_RUMBLE=0 still disables it. PR #273 (merged 03:15:47Z, v0.8.53) copies the guest's vibration struct before byte-swapping it; this game is not affected. Checked with LoHidTest (virtual SDL pad) and the config and menu tests. Not run: a physical DualSense, so how the levels feel is unchecked and no result is reported. The Issue was closed with the PR merge at 03:17:31Z. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Feature] display choice

fields.Evidence: Request (2026-10-04): choose the monitor for windowed and fullscreen modes without changing the primary display. PR #274 (merged 2026-10-07T03:42:11Z as 475d8c65, shipped in v0.8.53, published 2026-10-07T08:09:55Z, not accepted) adds a Display row (display_name + display_index). PR #276 (merged 07:08:08Z as 6ed90748, v0.8.53) follows the maintainer's test with three identical monitors: labels with number, model, size and position; Enter on Save now saves; a 5-second Keep/Revert prompt after a switch; Win+Shift+arrow moves are followed in windowed and fullscreen. #274 also removed exclusive fullscreen (Borderless is now called Fullscreen). The maintainer tested the switch on a Windows PC with three monitors on 2026-10-07, before the release, and accepted it (maintainer's report; no Issue comment records it; not the release package). Not tested: mixed DPI, native Linux, Android. The Issue was closed at 07:08:30Z. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Feature] GPU choice

fields.Evidence: Request (2026-10-04): add a rendering device selector for multi-GPU and Optimus systems, for Direct3D 12 and Vulkan. PR #274 (merged 2026-10-07T03:42:11Z as 475d8c65, shipped in v0.8.53, published 2026-10-07T08:09:55Z, not accepted) adds a GPU row to Graphics: Automatic plus the adapters the running backend lists (Direct3D 12, Vulkan, Metal), saved by name as gpu_device and applied after a restart; a missing or unusable adapter falls back to automatic with a warning; the row is hidden with one adapter and on Android. Checked on psvita (Proton Vulkan: Automatic gives RADV, llvmpipe by name gives llvmpipe, a missing name warns and falls back; Direct3D 12 lists one adapter, row hidden) and on an M1 Max (Metal). Not tested: Optimus or multi-adapter Direct3D 12 on Windows. The Issue was closed with the PR merge at 03:42:13Z. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: Publish the first-use pipeline stall fixes, display and audio settings in v0.8.53
items.body:
<!-- lo-project:release-v0-8-53 -->

v0.8.53 于 2026-10-07T08:09:55Z 发布。它不是草稿或预发布版本，是当前最新的正式版本，包含 v0.8.44 之后合并到 `main` 的全部工作。发布不等于验收：没有玩家验收，维护者只在发布前用开发版本检查过其中几项（见下），没有用 v0.8.53 的安装包验收。

## Scope and completion criteria

- [x] 带注释的 tag `v0.8.53`（tag 对象 `8dbdcb7b`）指向 `main` 上的提交 `c3bce085`（`docs: prepare v0.8.53 release notes`；前一个提交 `6a949890` 把源码版本号改为 0.8.53，之前是 PR #280 的合并 `8c1cde3c`）；版本号是 v0.8.44 加 0.0.9，按维护者的要求
- [x] Gitea Actions [run 401](https://git.zkx.ca/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/actions/runs/401)（API id 793，链接用 id）构建并发布 Windows ZIP、Linux AppImage、Linux Flatpak 和 Android APK：六个 job 全部成功，run 于 07:45:11Z 随 tag 推送创建，08:09:56Z 完成，从推送 tag 到公开约 25 分钟（草稿 0.2、FSR 输入 11.4、Android 6.7、Windows 7.5、Linux 10.1、发布 1.1 分钟）
- [x] 在维护者的 M1 Max 上用 `validation/mac-release-build.sh v0.8.53 v0.8.53 tag` 从 tag 构建 macOS 磁盘映像（DMG）（构建 37 秒，源码版本 0.8.53）：`hdiutil verify` 有效，`codesign --verify` 通过（ad hoc 签名），`Info.plist` 版本为 0.8.53；拷到 PC 后用 `gh release upload` 手工上传到草稿（GitHub 记录 07:46:33Z），早于 CI 安装包，不是 CI 产物
- [x] 着色器包没有变化：打 tag 前在 Mac 上对 `main` 的 `aa5f4b1a` 运行 `validation/mac-pack-check.sh`，两个契约不变（d3d12 `48cf14e3…`，vulkan `a7d1ab94…`），管线语料已列出，索引覆盖所有渲染器；tag 构建上 Linux job 的 "Check published shader packs" 步骤成功，日志列出同样的两个契约，没有发布新包
- [x] 发布页说明与 CHANGELOG 的 v0.8.53 一节一致（用 `tools/release/extract_release_notes.py` 比较，只差末尾换行）
- [ ] 取得玩家对 v0.8.53 的确认（五个 Issue 的报告者均未确认）
- [ ] 维护者验收 v0.8.53

## Delivery verification

发布页 [v0.8.53](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/releases/tag/v0.8.53) 的五个附件（大小和 SHA-256 为 GitHub API 在 2026-10-07 发布后读取的值）：

| 附件 | 字节数 | SHA-256 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `LostOdysseyRecomp-windows-x64-v0.8.53.zip` | 150,459,333 | `cb0efb1476f89684d2a44849ea13a90301e61ee0dc960b75969ac3c253b69284` |
| `LostOdysseyRecomp-linux-x64-v0.8.53.AppImage` | 76,478,968 | `ab22f1bd25fa13db1f0308508ec38c74ad628053abb48f02fa44c6ed60973889` |
| `LostOdysseyRecomp-linux-x64-v0.8.53.flatpak` | 54,289,688 | `3cb682337354cb799974d94ef3db04b9ed2eae485fbd8ef2727376f269823944` |
| `LostOdysseyRecomp-android-arm64-v0.8.53.apk` | 45,360,582 | `dde253af8cd34df696ababc4f538a4a132083f4a287dfa574e6e4621de959f11` |
| `LostOdysseyRecomp-macos-arm64-v0.8.53.dmg` | 60,616,756 | `814b0e27352e03a02a04c0a28e96555e349fc1335b3b76a9d54befd31615f4c5` |

DMG 只有 GitHub 的摘要，没有记录它与 Mac 上或 PC 上拷贝的哈希对照。四个 CI 安装包没有下载、解包或运行过。APK 由 CI 构建，用项目的调试密钥库签名，是实验性的。

## 本版本包含的工作

`git log --first-parent v0.8.44..v0.8.53` 中合并的 21 个 PR，全部是 tag 提交的祖先：

- 首次使用的管线卡顿（P2 到 P4，item `pipeline-first-use-stalls`）：[PR #260](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/260)（2026-10-06T22:52:01Z 合并）和 [PR #259](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/259)（23:12:35Z）让 Vulkan 游玩中第一次用到的管线由着色器部件链接而成；[PR #261](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/261)（23:54:57Z）按场景记录管线配方并在读盘时预建；[PR #262](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/262)（2026-10-07T00:23:04Z）把缺失的管线和与它共用着色器的管线放到共享的工作线程池上建好；[PR #263](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/263)（00:23:48Z）战斗巡游命令和 `tools/recipe_tour.py`；[PR #264](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/264)（00:24:17Z）下载预先录好的管线配方语料（3934 条，发布前的 2026-10-07T00:15Z 已上传到 `shader-packs` 预发布版本，不在发布页附件里）
- 设置：[PR #269](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/269)（03:01:14Z）保存 F1 调试菜单的快进设置（#104）；[PR #270](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/270)（03:17:30Z）震动强度滑块（#198），[PR #273](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/273)（03:15:47Z）XAM 震动请求在副本上做字节交换（这个游戏不受影响）；[PR #271](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/271)（03:35:13Z）5.1 环绕声输出（#174），[PR #279](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/279)（07:43:18Z）退回立体声时说明 Windows 声音控制面板的步骤；[PR #274](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/274)（03:42:11Z）GPU 和显示器选择，移除独占全屏（#202、#201），[PR #276](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/276)（07:08:08Z）设置里按 Enter 保存、同型号显示器按编号和位置区分、Win+Shift+方向键移动窗口
- 项目：[PR #280](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/280)（07:43:48Z）把 Discord #help 论坛的帖子复制到 GitHub Discussions 的仓库工作流，不在安装包里；它需要仓库密钥 `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN`，07:43:58Z 的一次手动运行（dry run）输出 "DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN is not set; nothing to sync."，所以还没有复制过任何帖子
- 测试和文档：[PR #272](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/272)（03:13:15Z，测试把帧生成 provider 4 当作 XeSS）；文档 [PR #258](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/258)、[#266](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/266)、[#267](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/267)、[#268](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/268)、[#277](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/277)、[#278](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/278)，以及提交 `b63661ff`、`04a55c78`、`880af248`（v0.8.44 的发布记录、同步和漂移核对）

各项的验证范围和限制记录在 docs/STATUS.md。

## Validation and acceptance

没有用 v0.8.53 安装包本身做过游戏运行，macOS 映像也没有从下载安装。没有玩家验收，#104、#174、#198、#201 和 #202 的报告者都没有确认。发布前维护者检查过其中三项，用的都不是发布的安装包：2026-10-06 在 TB321FU 平板上用 `2b5044af` 的调试版本检查首次使用的管线卡顿，并接受了效果；2026-10-07 在有三台显示器的 Windows PC 上检查显示器选择并接受（回复"没问题"）；在 HDMI 回音壁上按经典声音面板设为 7.1 后确认 5.1 可用（日志为 8 声道设备，5.1 流映射上去；维护者的说法，Issue 里没有评论记录）。震动强度没有在 DualSense 上试过，也没有反馈；5.1 没有在真正的 5.1 音箱、原生 Linux、macOS 和 Android 上试过；GPU 选择没有在 Optimus 或多适配器 Direct3D 12 上试过。维护者尚未验收 v0.8.53；发布不是玩家确认，也不是维护者验收。

fields.Evidence: Published v0.8.53 at 2026-10-07T08:09:55Z: latest release, annotated tag at commit c3bce085 on main, built and published by Gitea Actions run 401 (API id 793; six jobs succeeded, about 25 minutes from the tag push). Assets: Windows ZIP 150,459,333 B (SHA-256 cb0efb14...), Linux AppImage 76,478,968 B (ab22f1bd...), Flatpak 54,289,688 B (3cb68233...), Android APK 45,360,582 B (dde253af...; CI-built) and macOS DMG 60,616,756 B (814b0e27...; built on the maintainer's M1 Max from the tag, hdiutil verify valid, ad-hoc signature, uploaded by hand). No shader pack was published. Published, not accepted: 21 PRs from #258 to #280; no game run with the v0.8.53 packages and no player acceptance is recorded. The maintainer accepted the first-use stall result on a tablet debug build (2026-10-06) and the display choice on a three-monitor PC (2026-10-07), both before the release; 5.1 was reported working on an HDMI soundbar; vibration feel on a DualSense is not reported.

items.title: [Feature] Choose button prompt type

fields.Evidence: Request (2026-10-07): choose the button prompt type instead of following the last active controller. PR #320 (merged 2026-10-08T06:16:20Z as 91b66823, shipped in v0.8.61, published 08:33:11Z, not accepted) adds Settings > Gameplay > Button prompts: Auto (as before), Xbox or PlayStation; the in-game button atlas, the debug overlay and the menu glyphs follow it, applied and saved at once. Checked with the runtime build, LoMenuFlowTest (new row check), settings_menu contracts 5/5 and CPU contracts; not run in game. The Issue was closed with the merge at 06:16:22Z; the maintainer commented the release on 2026-10-08 at 08:34:56Z. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Bug] game launches to black screen after settings chosen-

fields.Evidence: Report (2026-10-07): the game starts to a black screen after the settings are chosen. A diagnostic build showed the NVIDIA driver walking its shader cache folder inside Direct3D 12 device creation (PR #300 body). On 2026-10-07 at 18:16 UTC the reporter was told to empty the NVIDIA DXCache and GLCache folders; the Issue was closed as completed at 18:49:36Z and no reporter reply after that is recorded. PR #300 (merged 19:22:49Z as cdf0b297, shipped in v0.8.61, published 2026-10-08T08:33:11Z, not accepted) keeps the diagnostics, not a workaround: a silent startup hang watch that logs the stuck step after 10 s, and LO_TRACE_STARTUP=1 for verbose lines (Windows x64). Checked with LoHangWatchTest (8/8), CPU contracts and psvita Proton starts; no run on a machine that hangs. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: [Bug] Flickering boat Experimental Staff

fields.Evidence: Report (2026-10-08): the boats at Experimental Staff Marine Division flicker. The boats are drawn with a jittered depth pre-pass and then unjittered passes on the same geometry (GEQUAL depth test), half a pixel apart, so part of the hull fails the test under TAA, FSR and DLSS. PR #312 (merged 2026-10-08T02:04:38Z as e08b2111, shipped in v0.8.61, published 08:33:11Z, not accepted) adds the four exact shader pairs to the reviewed jitter list. LoTemporalJitterTest --captured-issue307-boat passes against the reporter's banks; on psvita (Proton D3D12, FSR Quality, 1080p) pixels changing by more than 8/255 between frames at the boats went from 3.74% to 0.02%. Not checked on the reporter's NVIDIA DLAA setup; the animated water in that map is a separate, smaller item. Closed with the merge at 02:04:39Z. No reporter confirmation is recorded.

items.title: Migrate the runtime from SDL2 to SDL 3.4.18 (PR #289)
items.body:
<!-- lo-project:sdl3-runtime-migration -->

[PR #289](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/289)（Xarishark 贡献，2026-10-07T19:38:44Z 合并为 `e59bfa24`，没有关联 Issue）把运行时的 SDL 从 SDL2 迁移到固定的 `thirdparty/SDL` 子模块 SDL 3.4.18。v0.8.61 于 2026-10-08T08:33:11Z 发布并包含它；发布不等于验收。

## Scope and completion criteria

- [x] 手柄、键盘、鼠标、热插拔和震动，音频（排队音频改为 SDL3 音频流，保留 512 帧设备缓冲），窗口和显示器处理，安装器和更新器界面，plume 的 Vulkan 表面路径（`tools/patches/plume-sdl3.patch`），以及 Android 的 `SDLActivity` 和 JNI 包都改用 SDL 3
- [x] Linux 在可用时使用原生 Wayland 并请求高像素密度；Windows 在不同 DPI 的显示器之间保留窗口大小；Android 折叠、展开或旋转后不再拉伸画面
- [x] CI 和打包跟进：`review-regressions` 在找不到 SDL3 包时构建固定的 SDL，Linux 发布工作流安装 `libxtst-dev`，Android lint 使用 `packaging/android/lint.xml`
- [x] 已在 v0.8.61 发布；macOS 磁盘映像是第一个基于 SDL 3 构建的
- [ ] 取得玩家对 v0.8.61 的确认
- [ ] 补测：Android 和 macOS 的控制器热插拔、Android 控制器震动、只有 X11 的 Linux 会话、macOS 的 2x Retina 或 HDR 显示器

## Validation and acceptance

PR 正文和维护者的报告：Windows x64（clang-cl）上游戏、DInput 和 XInput 手柄、热插拔、震动、音频和干净退出；2026-10-07 维护者在合并内容上的运行：Windows x64 构建和 SDL 单元测试（含三显示器混合 DPI 的 `LoGameWindowPixelsTest`）、AMD Strix Halo 上的原生 Linux（GNOME Wayland，进入游戏，PipeWire 音频，Xbox Series X 和 DualSense 手柄）和 GE-Proton 下的 Windows 可执行文件（Direct3D 12 和 Vulkan）、M1 Max 上的 macOS arm64（new-game-battle 场景通过，30 FPS）、OPPO 折叠屏（Adreno 840）上的 Android arm64 APK，以及一次只构建不运行的 Gitea 发布打包。没有用 v0.8.61 的安装包运行过游戏，也没有玩家确认。

stage_detail: Published; not accepted

## Sources

- [PR #289](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/pull/289)
- [v0.8.61 发布页](https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/releases/tag/v0.8.61)
- docs/STATUS.md（SDL 3.4.18 迁移一行）

fields.Evidence: PR #289 (contributed by Xarishark; merged 2026-10-07T19:38:44Z as e59bfa24, shipped in v0.8.61, published 2026-10-08T08:33:11Z, not accepted) moves gamepads, keyboard, mouse, audio, window and display handling, the installer and updater UIs, the plume Vulkan surface path and the Android SDLActivity to the pinned SDL 3.4.18 submodule; Linux uses native Wayland where available. Maintainer's runs on the merged content (2026-10-07): Windows x64 with a three-monitor mixed-DPI test, native Linux on an AMD host under GNOME Wayland and the Windows build under GE-Proton, macOS arm64 on an M1 Max (new-game-battle scenario) and an Android arm64 APK on an OPPO foldable. Not validated: controller hotplug on Android and macOS, Android rumble, an X11-only Linux session, a 2x Retina or HDR display on macOS. items.title: v1.0.0: Replay upscaler motion only for geometry that moved
items.body:
<!-- lo-project:sr-motion-replay-moving-only -->

## Summary and objectives

Upscaler motion vectors come from replaying every scene draw a second time. On the #172 reporter's RX 6600 / i7-8700K, FSR Performance at 4K (50 FPS on v0.8.61) stays about a third slower than the same 1080p internal image without FSR; most of that gap is FSR itself and the motion replay. Replay only the draws that moved since the previous frame and take the rest from camera reprojection of depth (the existing hybrid fallback).

## Scope and completion criteria

- [ ] Measure first: share of static draws per frame and the CPU/GPU the replay costs in towns, fields, battles and cutscenes.
- [ ] Classify a draw as moving when its transforms, bone or other vertex-shader constants, or vertex data changed; misclassification must err towards replaying.
- [ ] No new ghosting on moving characters, NPCs, enemies, boats, animated foliage or particles with FSR, DLSS, XeSS and TAA.
- [ ] Measured gain with FSR on a CPU-limited setup.

## Status — 2026-10-08

Scheduled by the maintainer for before v1.0.0 after the #172 reporter's v0.8.61 numbers. Not started.

## Sources

- https://github.com/freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp/issues/172#issuecomment-6066318946
- LostOdysseyRecomp/gpu/sr_hybrid_motion.h
